title: ui(grid): a column summary `sum` on a record-mode amount sends a raw aggregate the engine refuses, and the footer loses every whole-set total
body:
domain:ui#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAmxB38cjBXwr9FZGyt

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named landing and a measured reach.

## What is wrong

A list or grid view whose column declares `summary: 'sum'` on a `record`-mode currency amount sends one ungrouped whole-set query. `useWholeSetSummary` (`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useWholeSetSummary.ts`) builds it through `compileWholeSetSummaryQuery`, as `{ count, sum(amount), … }` over the whole filter. ADR-0144 D6 refuses a raw aggregate across currencies, and the engine enforces it. Since PR #32216 that includes an amount that follows its parent's currency (`currencyField: 'invoice.currency_code'`).

So the query is refused, and that costs every other column in the same query:

- The record-mode column's own footer never draws the figure, which is honest (`useColumnSummary` skips record mode).
- Every other summarised column in that view silently falls back from the whole-set figure to the figure for the current page. The footer then shows a page total under a label that reads as the total of the view.
- Each page load issues one refused request.

## Reach

Measured by the #31912 card thread on `origin/main` `ac9622e3` with the real renderers. The premise table is `card-31912/premise-ac9622e3.md` in the `domain:ui#3` seat's project files, row G. The same holds for a sibling `currencyField`, so this is not new with the parent path.

## Business reason

A finance user who adds a Subtotal sum to an invoice-line view reads page totals as whole-set totals on every other column. Nothing on screen says the figures changed meaning.

## Ask

- The whole-set summary query leaves out a sum or avg over a `record`-mode amount, whether the pointer is a sibling or a parent path, so the other columns keep their whole-set figures.
- If a per-currency total is wanted, it is grouped by the code. That is a product choice and is not part of this card.
- Pins: a view with one record-mode sum and one plain-number sum. The plain column keeps its whole-set figure, and no refused request is sent. Each pin has an ablation.

## Who acts

`domain:ui#3`, after #31912 lands, because it touches the same `plugin-grid` projection seam. Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue compileWholeSetSummaryQuery` gave 0 hits. `whole-set summary record currency` and `footer summary record-mode amount` gave no card for this defect (#31912 is the source, not a duplicate).
